source.document: NASA-STD-6012A Corrosion Protection for Space Flight Hardware

notes: Anodic index units are 0.01 V increments.
All corrosion-resistant steels in this table are passivated.
Table 1 is guidance for coupling dissimilar metals and supports Tier A screening.
footnotes: Footnote 1: circle markers indicate relative anodic/cathodic direction within the guidance matrix.
Footnote 2: Group 0 includes all conductive carbon forms, including carbon composites, graphite, pitch carbons, carbon black, vitreous carbons, carbon/carbon, graphene, and PICA.
